channel.title: Extinction Rebellion Australia - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Extinction Rebellion Australia (ausrebellion.earth)

item.title: XR QLD REBEL WINS CHALLENGE AGAINST BRISBANE CITY COUNCIL
item.description: Brisbane City Council's six year long ban on XR's use of council's library meeting rooms has been overturned, and found to be discrimination on the basis of political belief and activity. Brisbane XR member Miree Le Roy (fourth from left) self-represented against a pool of senior counsels and lawyers from the Council. (photo by Lucy Stone)

item.title: ‘LABOR ASLEEP ON CLIMATE’ AS AUS COAL AND GAS EXPORTS DESTROY THE FUTURE
item.description: Protesters across the country came out in pyjamas outside MP offices to expose the consequences of Labor's disastrously weak emissions reduction targets and approval of new fossil fuel projects.

item.title: PROTESTS, GUERRILLA GARDENING AND DIRECT ACTION BY ‘WHOSE FUTURE’ COALITION
item.description: A week of action in Melbourne (Naarm) to inspire resistance to the profit-driven systems of oppression driving climate chaos, genocide and colonial violence, and urge us to imagine better ways of living.

item.title: XR TAS REBELS STAND UP FOR THREATENED SPECIES
item.description: Last weekend's protest in Launceston Mall highlighted Australia’s extinction crisis. Australia has the fastest rate of mammal extinction in the world, and more than 2,000 species are listed as threatened.

item.title: XR SA ACTIVISTS PADDLE FOR THE PLANET; WATER IS LIFE!
item.description: As nations gather in Brazil for the COP30 climate conference, rebels and friends from XRSA kayaked and paddle-boated on the Torrens river to send a message that we must #EndFossilFuelsNow to protect our oceans, rivers and ground water systems from the ravages of climate heating. Water is Life!

item.title: RISING TIDE STANDS WITH COAL WORKERS
item.description: In another epic Rising Tide protest at the Port of Newcastle, campaigners demanded federal government cancel planned fossil fuel projects and tax existing operations at 78%.

item.title: XRSA SAY: LOVE TDU, DUMP SANTOS
item.description: “By profiteering from extracting, burning and exporting dirty oil and gas, Santos is fuelling the race to extinction – driving the fires, floods and heatwaves that threaten the safety of our communities”—Dr Suzanne, XRSA

item.title: #dropwoodside takeover of WA Museum Boola Bardip
item.description: XRWA are proud to be part of the new Drop Woodside campaign, sparked by an exciting action on Feb 1 at Boola Bardip by the Voices For Climate Collective and friends from the Boorloo climate action community.

item.title: Carbon Capture is a Scam
item.description: Protesters confronted Resources Minister Madeline King during her keynote speech at the Carbon Capture and Storage Conference in Melbourne this week.

item.title: Thousands across Australia march to end native forest logging and mining
item.description: Marches organised by the Bob Brown Foundation drew 15,000 people across 14 locations. Commonwealth powers must be used to protect native forests and wildlife - sign the declaration!
